name: Pad Lights
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: The pads as a light show when idle; optional key-coloured beat pulse or 32-beat phrase countdown.
description: Idle show (default): the pads glow in a slow colour wave on a side whose deck is stopped or empty, so the deck you're playing keeps its own hot-cue colours. Beat pulse: the playing side's pads pulse on every beat in a colour from the track's key. Phrase countdown: the pads fill over 32 beats from when the track started, and the last bar flashes red. Off returns every pad to normal. Changes pad colours only: no controls, audio or library writes.
